issues.detail: The instructions do not cover all error scenarios, such as network failures or malformed responses.

scenarios.name: search-jobs-with-filters
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required command line but does not show JSON output, whereas Response A does not contain the command line at all.

scenarios.name: update-basic-resume
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required command lines (though with minor formatting differences) but omits the server confirmation, whereas Response B fails to provide any commands.

scenarios.name: apply-job-with-confirmation
scenarios.rationale: Both responses provide the required search and apply commands, but neither includes an explicit confirmation prompt; Response A offers more detail and a review comment, making it slightly better.
